title: Mary Quant Put Everyday Movement into Fashion

paragraphs.text: Mary Quant's Bazaar opened in London in 1955, bringing design and retail into the same small enterprise.
paragraphs.translation: Mary Quant的Bazaar于1955年在伦敦开业，把设计与零售放进同一家小型企业。

paragraphs.text: The V&A describes an early cycle in which one day's sales financed cloth for clothes made overnight.
paragraphs.translation: V&A介绍，其早期生产循环是：一天的销售收入，为连夜制作服装所需的布料提供资金。

paragraphs.text: To shift stock quickly was therefore part of keeping the next day's production possible.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，迅速卖出存货，是让次日生产得以进行的一部分。

paragraphs.text: Her short shift dresses offered a shape that did not depend on a tightly defined waist.
paragraphs.translation: 她的短直筒裙提供了一种不依赖鲜明收腰的轮廓。

paragraphs.text: In a 1958 grey-flannel outfit, she also reworked the historical associations of a shift worn as an undergarment.
paragraphs.translation: 在一套1958年的灰色法兰绒服装中，她还改写了旧式贴身内衣shift所承载的历史联想。

paragraphs.text: Someone conventional in dress might find such play with underclothes surprising.
paragraphs.translation: 衣着循俗的人，可能会对这种借用内衣的设计游戏感到惊讶。

paragraphs.text: A conservative suit, by contrast, can make familiarity itself part of its appeal.
paragraphs.translation: 相比之下，一套式样传统的套装，可以把熟悉感本身变成吸引力的一部分。

paragraphs.text: To dress conservatively is one way of taking a place within an existing visual language.
paragraphs.translation: 穿着得保守传统，是在既有视觉语言中取得位置的一种方式。

paragraphs.text: Conventionalism can make that language seem fixed even when its forms have changed across generations.
paragraphs.translation: 循守惯例的态度，能够让那种语言显得固定不变，即使其形式在世代之间已经改变。

paragraphs.text: A medium-sized dress must still be shaped for a particular sizing system and intended fit.
paragraphs.translation: 一件中码连衣裙，仍须依据特定尺码体系和预期合身程度来裁制。

paragraphs.text: A medium-grey cloth can give the same outline a quieter presence than a brilliant colour.
paragraphs.translation: 中灰色布料，可以让同一种轮廓比鲜亮颜色显得更沉静。

paragraphs.text: Medium-weight fabric falls differently from a very light one, so the material can alter the apparent structure.
paragraphs.translation: 中等厚度的布料，与很轻的布料垂坠方式不同，因此材料能够改变看起来的结构。

paragraphs.text: If a garment is reversible, both faces need finishing suitable for being seen.
paragraphs.translation: 一件衣服若要双面穿，两面就都需要适合外露的收口处理。

paragraphs.text: Reverse it and the inward surface becomes the outward one, changing its visible relations.
paragraphs.translation: 把它翻过来，里面的表面便成为外面，从而改变可见的关系。

paragraphs.text: The new look gathered momentum as clothes, shops and images reinforced one another.
paragraphs.translation: 随着衣服、店铺与图像相互加强，新面貌积聚了发展势头。

title: A Bladder Must Empty as Well as Fill

paragraphs.text: Urinary retention occurs when some or all of the urine cannot be emptied from the bladder.
paragraphs.translation: 部分或全部尿液无法从膀胱排出时，就出现了尿潴留。

paragraphs.text: The NIDDK distinguishes a sudden acute form from a chronic form that develops over time.
paragraphs.translation: 美国NIDDK把突然发生的急性类型，与逐渐发展的慢性类型区分开。

paragraphs.text: A person with chronic retention may still pass urine while leaving a substantial amount behind.
paragraphs.translation: 有慢性潴留的人，仍可能排出尿液，却把相当一部分留在膀胱里。

paragraphs.text: The retained urine can allow bacteria to multiply and can place stress on the bladder and urinary system.
paragraphs.translation: 潴留的尿液可能让细菌繁殖，并给膀胱与泌尿系统造成负担。

paragraphs.text: Repeated infections can become a persistent problem when the underlying difficulty remains.
paragraphs.translation: 根本困难仍然存在时，反复感染可能成为一再出现的问题。

paragraphs.text: Symptoms may be less obvious in the chronic form than in a sudden inability to urinate.
paragraphs.translation: 与突然无法排尿相比，慢性类型的症状可能不那么明显。

paragraphs.text: Sudden inability to urinate requires immediate emergency medical attention, according to the NIDDK.
paragraphs.translation: NIDDK指出，突然无法排尿需要立即接受急诊处理。

title: The Small Structure That Carries a Replacement Tooth

paragraphs.text: A replacement tooth needs a way to stay where biting and chewing will put forces upon it.
paragraphs.translation: 替代牙需要一种固定方式，使它能在承受咬合与咀嚼力量的位置保持不动。

paragraphs.text: A fixed dental bridge spans a gap by obtaining support from one or more neighbouring teeth.
paragraphs.translation: 固定牙桥借助一颗或多颗邻牙的支持，跨过缺牙形成的空隙。

paragraphs.text: Its retainer connects the replacement to that support.
paragraphs.translation: 牙桥固位体把替代牙与支撑结构连接起来。

paragraphs.text: A conventional bridge uses a crown fitted over a prepared supporting tooth.
paragraphs.translation: 传统牙桥使用套在经过制备的支持牙上的牙冠。

paragraphs.text: An adhesive bridge instead uses a small metal wing attached behind an adjacent tooth.
paragraphs.translation: 黏接牙桥则使用固定在邻牙背面的小金属翼。

paragraphs.text: An impression allows a technician to make the bridge for the actual arrangement of the patient's teeth.
paragraphs.translation: 印模使技师能够依据患者牙齿的实际排列制作牙桥。

paragraphs.text: Clinical fitting then checks the result, and modifications may be needed before the final placement.
paragraphs.translation: 随后，临床试戴检验结果，在最终安放前可能还需要修改。

paragraphs.text: The aim is to restore function and appearance within a mouth that keeps moving and changing.
paragraphs.translation: 目标是在不断运动和变化的口腔中，恢复功能与外观。

paragraphs.text: Restoration of chewing involves the relation between surfaces, supports and the forces they carry.
paragraphs.translation: 咀嚼功能的恢复，涉及各个表面、支撑结构及其所承受力量之间的关系。

paragraphs.text: Later cleaning remains part of the bridge's working life, especially around the supporting teeth and beneath the replacement.
paragraphs.translation: 之后的清洁仍是牙桥使用过程的一部分，尤其要照顾支持牙周围及替代牙下方。

paragraphs.text: A retentive bandage holds a dressing in position, whereas the dental bridge's retainer holds a prosthetic structure against its support.
paragraphs.translation: 固位绷带把敷料固定在位，而牙桥的固位体则把修复结构固定在其支撑部位。

paragraphs.text: St John Ambulance's guidance explains that bandages have different supporting and securing functions, while excessive tightness can restrict circulation.
paragraphs.translation: 圣约翰急救组织的指南说明，绷带有不同的支撑和固定功能，但过紧会限制血液循环。

title: The Eye Brings Its Recent Past into a Dark Room

paragraphs.text: Entering a dim room does not instantly give the eye its greatest sensitivity to dim light.
paragraphs.translation: 进入昏暗房间，并不会立刻让眼睛获得对弱光的最大敏感度。

paragraphs.text: Dark adaptation takes time, so the same room can look different after the eye has adjusted.
paragraphs.translation: 暗适应需要时间，因此，眼睛调节之后，同一个房间看起来也可能不同。

paragraphs.text: NYU's perception demonstrations describe how two eyes exposed to different lighting beforehand can show different sensitivities.
paragraphs.translation: 纽约大学的知觉演示说明，事先处于不同照明条件中的两只眼睛，可以呈现不同的敏感度。

paragraphs.text: The eye is housed within an orbit, the socket formed by bones around it.
paragraphs.translation: 眼睛容纳在眼眶内，眼眶是周围骨骼形成的窝状结构。

paragraphs.text: Its orbital surroundings provide space for the muscles, nerves and other structures involved in its work.
paragraphs.translation: 眼眶周围为参与眼部活动的肌肉、神经及其他结构提供空间。

paragraphs.text: The socket is a supporting structure, while the retina and nervous system participate in turning light into information.
paragraphs.translation: 眼眶是支撑结构，而视网膜与神经系统参与把光转化为信息。

paragraphs.text: Rods are especially important in very dim conditions, when colour discrimination becomes limited.
paragraphs.translation: 视杆细胞在极暗条件下尤为重要，此时辨色能力受到限制。

paragraphs.text: A faint object can sometimes be easier to detect a little away from direct central vision, as the NYU material explains.
paragraphs.translation: 纽约大学的材料解释，某个微弱物体有时在稍偏离正中央视线的位置更容易被察觉。

paragraphs.text: The wider nervous system carries information through cells whose membranes maintain electrical differences.
paragraphs.translation: 更广泛的神经系统，通过细胞传递信息；这些细胞的膜维持着电势差。

paragraphs.text: At a chemical synapse, a neurotransmitter released by one neuron can bind to receptors on another.
paragraphs.translation: 在化学突触处，一个神经元释放的神经递质，可以与另一个神经元上的受体结合。

paragraphs.text: OpenStax describes this communication as electrochemical: electrical activity along a neuron is joined to chemical signalling between cells.
paragraphs.translation: OpenStax把这种交流描述为电化学过程：沿神经元的电活动，与细胞之间的化学信号连接在一起。

paragraphs.text: The chemical signal also has to be cleared, through processes such as breakdown, diffusion or reuptake.
paragraphs.translation: 化学信号还必须通过分解、扩散或再摄取等过程被清除。

title: The Person Left Behind in The Cherry Orchard

paragraphs.text: The last act of Chekhov's The Cherry Orchard begins in a room already losing the signs of a home.
paragraphs.translation: 契诃夫《樱桃园》的最后一幕，开始于一间已经逐渐失去家居痕迹的房间。

paragraphs.text: Pictures and curtains have gone, luggage waits, and the remaining furniture is piled aside.
paragraphs.translation: 画与窗帘已不见，行李在等待，剩下的家具堆在一旁。

paragraphs.text: A timetable presses upon the farewell: the characters must leave for the train.
paragraphs.translation: 时刻表催迫着告别：人物们必须动身赶火车。

paragraphs.text: They have to shift, in the informal sense of hurrying, even while some wish to look once more at the walls.
paragraphs.translation: 他们必须赶快行动，尽管有些人还想再看一眼墙壁。

paragraphs.text: Earlier in the play, Lopakhin had proposed a shift: divide the land into building plots and lease them for summer cottages to save the estate.
paragraphs.translation: 在剧本较早处，洛帕欣曾提出一个权宜办法：把土地划成建房地块，出租供人建夏日别墅，以挽救庄园。

paragraphs.text: Lopakhin, whose father and grandfather had been serfs on the estate, has bought the property.
paragraphs.translation: 洛帕欣买下了这份地产，而他的父亲与祖父曾在这里当农奴。

paragraphs.text: The sale reverses the old relation between owning family and servant family.
paragraphs.translation: 出售把原先主人家庭与仆人家庭之间的关系颠倒了。

paragraphs.text: For the former owners, a place filled with memory becomes property they must yield to someone else.
paragraphs.translation: 对原先的主人而言，充满记忆的地方，成为必须交给别人的财产。

paragraphs.text: Elsewhere in the same act, Pischin returns money after leasing land containing valuable clay.
paragraphs.translation: 在同一幕的另一处，Pischin出租了含有贵重黏土的土地，随后回来还钱。

paragraphs.text: His land contains an exploitable resource that he had not previously turned into this income.
paragraphs.translation: 他的土地含有一种可开发的资源，而此前他并未靠它取得这笔收入。

paragraphs.text: The tenants plan to exploit the clay, while the lease gives him money to pay creditors.
paragraphs.translation: 承租者计划开发黏土，而租赁让他得到偿还债权人的钱。

paragraphs.text: This planned exploitation places a different value on the ground from the beauty of an orchard.
paragraphs.translation: 这种计划中的开发，赋予土地一种不同于果园之美的价值。

paragraphs.text: Varya will take work as a housekeeper elsewhere, and Charlotta asks for a new position.
paragraphs.translation: Varya将在别处当管家，Charlotta则请求别人为她找一份新工作。

paragraphs.text: Each must find a way to shift for herself when the household's familiar structure dissolves.
paragraphs.translation: 熟悉的家庭结构瓦解时，每个人都必须找到独自谋生的办法。

paragraphs.text: Varya must make shift with the new work available to her, as the estate no longer supplies her place.
paragraphs.translation: Varya必须靠能找到的新工作设法过下去，因为庄园已不再为她提供原来的位置。

paragraphs.text: They must shift as best they can, although their prospects are very different.
paragraphs.translation: 他们必须尽可能设法过下去，尽管各自的前景很不相同。

paragraphs.text: The furniture may be shiftable, but the human ties cannot be packed into the same boxes.
paragraphs.translation: 家具可以搬走，人与人之间的联系却无法装进同样的箱子。

paragraphs.text: Anya imagines study, work and reading with her mother, giving the departure an emerging hope as well as a loss.
paragraphs.translation: Anya想象着求学、工作和与母亲一起阅读，使离别既包含失落，也包含正在出现的希望。

paragraphs.text: Fiers, the elderly footman, belongs to the household as an old retainer whose attention still centres on its masters.
paragraphs.translation: 年迈男仆Fiers是多年忠心服侍这家人的老仆，他的注意仍围绕着主人们。

paragraphs.text: The retainer's place recalls a historical order in which service formed a lasting personal attachment to a great household.
paragraphs.translation: 这位家仆的位置，让人想到一种历史秩序：服侍构成了对大户人家持久的人身依附。

paragraphs.text: Other characters say or assume that he has been sent to hospital.
paragraphs.translation: 其他人物说或以为，他已被送往医院。

paragraphs.text: Their statements pass from person to person until an uncertain action sounds like a completed one.
paragraphs.translation: 这些说法在人与人之间传递，直到一项尚不确定的行动，听起来像是已经完成。

paragraphs.text: The audience finally sees him enter the empty house and try its locked door.
paragraphs.translation: 观众最后看见他走进空屋，试了试锁住的门。

paragraphs.text: The locks constrain him within the house after the carriages have left.
paragraphs.translation: 马车离开后，门锁把他禁闭在屋内。

paragraphs.text: His final constraint is literal confinement, while his thoughts remain with the coat his master should have worn.
paragraphs.translation: 他最后受到的是实实在在的禁闭，而心里仍想着主人本该穿哪件外套。

paragraphs.text: The sound of axes continues beyond the room.
paragraphs.translation: 斧声继续从房间外传来。

paragraphs.text: Chekhov lets different times coexist: memory, urgent departure, promised work and the irreversible cutting of trees.
paragraphs.translation: 契诃夫让不同的时间并存：记忆、迫切的离去、应许的工作，以及不可挽回的砍树。

paragraphs.text: Anyone adapting the play for the screen would have to decide how to carry that final arrangement of empty space, an unseen axe and an overlooked man into a new medium.
paragraphs.translation: 任何把这部剧改编为银幕作品的人，都必须决定怎样把空荡的空间、看不见的斧头和被遗忘的人这一最终组合，带入新的媒介。

paragraphs.text: A camera could follow the departing people outside, but doing so would change what the audience knows about the locked house.
paragraphs.translation: 镜头可以跟着离去的人走到屋外，但这样做会改变观众对于那栋锁住的房屋所知道的情况。

paragraphs.text: Keeping the room in view instead would preserve the uncomfortable knowledge that the departure has left a person behind.
paragraphs.translation: 若让房间继续留在视野里，则会保留那份令人不安的知情：这场离去把一个人留在了身后。

title: An Objection Given a Place in the Procedure

paragraphs.text: Richard Burtsell's 1907 encyclopedia account describes such an office in the Catholic processes of beatification and canonization.
paragraphs.translation: Richard Burtsell在1907年的百科条目中，介绍了天主教宣福与封圣程序里的这样一个职位。

paragraphs.text: The devil's advocate, officially the Promoter of the Faith, had to prepare written objections to a proposed recognition.
paragraphs.translation: 这位俗称devil's advocate、正式称为信仰促进官的审查员，必须针对拟议的认可准备书面异议。

paragraphs.text: The account also required attention to procedural omissions and objections that might otherwise be passed over.
paragraphs.translation: 这份记述还要求关注程序遗漏，以及其他情况下可能被略过的异议。

paragraphs.text: Institutional duty constrained the official to raise difficulties even when a favourable decision was widely desired.
paragraphs.translation: 制度职责迫使这位官员提出难点，即使人们普遍希望作出有利决定。

paragraphs.text: An official who shifts when pressed for a clear objection would evade the very work the office assigns.
paragraphs.translation: 一个在被要求明确提出异议时闪烁推托的官员，会逃避该职位所赋予的那项工作。

paragraphs.text: In a modern discussion, a devil's advocate may test a proposal by presenting objections without personally believing every one of them.
paragraphs.translation: 在现代讨论中，主动唱反调的人可以提出异议来检验方案，而不必本人相信其中每一条。

paragraphs.text: That role requires a coherent speaker who can make the objection intelligible to other people.
paragraphs.translation: 这一角色需要能够清楚表达的人，使别人听懂异议。

paragraphs.text: Speaking incoherently would make even a useful objection difficult to examine.
paragraphs.translation: 表达得不连贯，会使有用的异议也难以审视。

paragraphs.text: A yielding participant may accept the first confident answer before its implications have been worked through.
paragraphs.translation: 性格顺从的参与者，可能在问题的含义尚未想清楚前，就接受第一个自信的回答。

paragraphs.text: A habitual yielder can lose the opportunity to explain a difficulty that others have not noticed.
paragraphs.translation: 惯常让步的人，可能失去说明某个别人未曾察觉的难点的机会。

paragraphs.text: Agreement given yieldingly may express a wish to end an uncomfortable exchange rather than a settled conviction.
paragraphs.translation: 顺从地表示的同意，可能表达的是结束不自在交谈的愿望，而非已经形成的确信。

paragraphs.text: Pressure can constrain assent, producing the appearance of consent without resolving the original question.
paragraphs.translation: 压力能够强求赞同，制造同意的表象，却没有解决原来的问题。

paragraphs.text: A chair can give an objection time by asking the current speaker to yield the floor.
paragraphs.translation: 主持人可以请当前发言者让出发言权，为异议留出时间。

paragraphs.text: Yielding speaking time does not require the speaker to yield to an opposing view.
paragraphs.translation: 让出发言时间，并不要求发言者屈从于对立意见。

paragraphs.text: One may yield to none in respect for a shared institution and still question one of its decisions.
paragraphs.translation: 一个人对共同制度的尊重，可以不亚于任何人，同时仍质疑其某项决定。

title: Returning the Gas Is Only Half of Reversing the Process

paragraphs.text: Imagine an insulated container divided into two halves, with an ideal gas in one half and a vacuum in the other.
paragraphs.translation: 设想一个被分成两半的绝热容器：一半装有理想气体，另一半是真空。

paragraphs.text: Remove the partition and the gas spreads into the available volume.
paragraphs.translation: 移去隔板，气体便扩散到可用的体积中。

paragraphs.text: OpenStax uses this expansion to introduce a question deeper than whether a piston could later compress the gas.
paragraphs.translation: OpenStax用这种膨胀，引入一个比活塞以后能否压回气体更深入的问题。

paragraphs.text: Could the entire change be undone while both gas and surroundings returned to their initial states?
paragraphs.translation: 能否在气体与周围环境都回到初态的同时，把整个变化撤销？

paragraphs.text: A reversible process must allow that complete return, not simply restore the gas's pressure and temperature.
paragraphs.translation: 可逆过程必须容许这种完整返回，而不只是恢复气体的压强与温度。

paragraphs.text: Reversibility consequently refers to a relation between the system and its surroundings.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，可逆性所指的是系统与周围环境之间的关系。

paragraphs.text: Pushing the expanded gas back can require work and the removal of heat.
paragraphs.translation: 把膨胀后的气体压回去，可能需要做功并移走热量。

paragraphs.text: The gas may then regain its former state while its surroundings carry the consequences of the operation.
paragraphs.translation: 之后，气体可能恢复原状态，而环境承受了这次操作带来的结果。

paragraphs.text: An ideal process carried out reversibly would leave no such net change outside the restored system.
paragraphs.translation: 一个以可逆方式进行的理想过程，不会在恢复后的系统以外留下这样的净变化。

paragraphs.text: Slow, nearly balanced changes help construct that ideal, although slowness alone does not remove friction or every source of dissipation.
paragraphs.translation: 缓慢、接近平衡的变化有助于构造这个理想，但仅有缓慢，并不能消除摩擦或一切耗散来源。

paragraphs.text: In a real device, friction and heat leaks can intervene and prevent the intended return.
paragraphs.translation: 在实际装置中，摩擦与漏热可能介入，妨碍预期的恢复。

paragraphs.text: A related mechanical idea concerns conservative forces, such as ideal gravity or an ideal spring force.
paragraphs.translation: 另一个相关的力学概念涉及保守力，例如理想重力或理想弹簧力。

paragraphs.text: Their work between two positions does not depend on the chosen path.
paragraphs.translation: 它们在两个位置之间所做的功，不取决于选取的路径。

paragraphs.text: The work around a closed path is zero when the force is conservative over that path and its domain.
paragraphs.translation: 当力在相关路径及其定义区域中为保守力时，沿闭合路径所做的功为零。

paragraphs.text: This lets potential energy describe the relation between position and recoverable mechanical work.
paragraphs.translation: 这使势能能够描述位置与可恢复机械功之间的关系。

paragraphs.text: Frictional dissipation instead makes the route and the amount of sliding matter.
paragraphs.translation: 摩擦耗散则使路径与滑动量变得重要。

title: An Old Arithmetic Word and a Curve Made by Unwinding

paragraphs.text: The 1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica used evolution as a term in arithmetic.
paragraphs.translation: 1911年版《大英百科全书》把evolution用作一个算术术语。

paragraphs.text: In its arithmetic account, evolution extracts a root from a given power.
paragraphs.translation: 在其算术说明中，开方从给定的幂求出根。

paragraphs.text: For positive numbers, taking the cube root of 27 returns 3, undoing the cubing of 3.
paragraphs.translation: 对于正数，对27开立方得到3，撤销了对3求立方的运算。

paragraphs.text: The companion operation, involution, raises a number to a power.
paragraphs.translation: 与之相对的运算involution，是对一个数求幂。

paragraphs.text: The two operations act reversely within that historical vocabulary, moving from root to power and from power to root.
paragraphs.translation: 在这套历史词汇中，两种运算以相反方式作用：一种由根到幂，另一种由幂到根。

paragraphs.text: Such arithmetic served divers practical needs, from commercial reckoning to the calculations required in technical work.
paragraphs.translation: 这类算术服务于种种实际需要，从商业核算到技术工作所需的计算。

paragraphs.text: Repeated multiplication by 3 gives 1, 3, 9, 27 and 81 when the sequence begins with the zeroth power.
paragraphs.translation: 数列从零次幂开始，反复乘以3，得到1、3、9、27与81。

paragraphs.text: Reverse the list and it runs 81, 27, 9, 3, 1.
paragraphs.translation: 把这个列表逆序排列，就得到81、27、9、3、1。

paragraphs.text: This reverse order does not itself perform every possible inverse calculation.
paragraphs.translation: 这种相反顺序，本身并未完成所有可能的逆运算。

paragraphs.text: It displays the selected powers in reverse, while a root calculation asks for a number satisfying a specified relation.
paragraphs.translation: 它以逆序展示选定的幂，而求根运算要求找到满足指定关系的数。

paragraphs.text: For example, squaring both 3 and negative 3 gives 9, although the principal square root of 9 is 3.
paragraphs.translation: 例如，3与负3的平方都是9，尽管9的算术平方根是3。

paragraphs.text: The evolution of a curve can be represented by unwinding a taut thread from it, with the free end tracing an involute.
paragraphs.translation: 曲线的展开可以用从曲线上解绕一根绷紧的线来表示，线的自由端描出渐开线。

paragraphs.text: For a circle, MacTutor describes the equivalent construction using a point on a straight line rolling around the circle.
paragraphs.translation: 对于圆，MacTutor以一条绕圆滚动的直线上的点，描述等价构造。

paragraphs.text: The resulting involute has the original circle as its evolute.
paragraphs.translation: 所得渐开线，以原来的圆作为其渐屈线。

paragraphs.text: MacTutor connects Huygens's study of such curves with the search for clocks that could keep useful time at sea.
paragraphs.translation: MacTutor把惠更斯对这类曲线的研究，与寻找能够在海上准确计时的钟表联系起来。

paragraphs.text: Timekeeping mattered for longitude because local solar time could be compared with a reference time.
paragraphs.translation: 计时对确定经度很重要，因为地方太阳时可以与参考时间比较。

paragraphs.text: A geometric construction could therefore belong to the practical problem of finding a ship's position.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，一个几何构造能够参与确定船舶位置这一实际问题。

paragraphs.text: In a notebook, a learner can draw the winding construction on one side of a leaf and put the inverse relation on the reverse.
paragraphs.translation: 在笔记本里，学习者可以在一张书叶的一面画出绕线作图，在反面写出逆向关系。

title: Bandung Asked Who Could Speak for a New State

paragraphs.text: In April 1955, representatives of twenty-nine Asian and African governments met in Bandung, Indonesia.
paragraphs.translation: 1955年4月，二十九个亚非国家政府的代表在印度尼西亚万隆开会。

paragraphs.text: The gathering connected decolonization with questions of development, peace and cultural cooperation.
paragraphs.translation: 这次集会把非殖民化与发展、和平及文化合作问题连接起来。

paragraphs.text: For emergent states newly established after colonial rule, sovereignty had an immediate practical meaning.
paragraphs.translation: 对殖民统治结束后新建的国家而言，主权有着直接而实际的意义。

paragraphs.text: An emergent international voice could ask how these countries would act together rather than only through the priorities of larger powers.
paragraphs.translation: 一种正在形成的国际声音，可以提出这些国家怎样共同行动，而不只是服从大国的优先事项。

paragraphs.text: The meeting made room for governments with different alliances and political views.
paragraphs.translation: 会议为联盟归属和政治观点不同的政府提供了空间。

paragraphs.text: The principles emphasized self-determination, equality, non-aggression and non-interference in internal affairs.
paragraphs.translation: 这些原则强调自决、平等、互不侵犯与不干涉内政。

paragraphs.text: An interventionist policy claims a role in the affairs of another country.
paragraphs.translation: 干涉主义政策主张介入另一个国家的事务。

paragraphs.text: An interventionist may defend such action, whereas the Bandung principle placed weight on the state's own authority.
paragraphs.translation: 干涉主义支持者可能为这种行动辩护，而万隆原则重视国家自身的权威。

paragraphs.text: The dispute over interventionism concerns who may act, on what grounds, and with what relation to sovereignty.
paragraphs.translation: 围绕干涉主义的争论，涉及谁可以行动、依据何在，以及行动与主权是什么关系。

paragraphs.text: A stronger power can intervene in a domestic conflict through support, pressure or direct involvement.
paragraphs.translation: 强国可以通过支持、施压或直接参与，干预国内冲突。

paragraphs.text: It may exploit a crisis to obtain influence that would be harder to gain in more stable conditions.
paragraphs.translation: 它可能利用危机取得影响力，而在较稳定的情况下，这种影响力更难获得。

paragraphs.text: Such exploitation of vulnerability gives non-interference a meaning beyond diplomatic politeness.
paragraphs.translation: 这种对脆弱处境的利用，使不干涉具有超出外交礼貌的意义。

paragraphs.text: Some participating governments remained within the political orbit of established alliances.
paragraphs.translation: 一些参会政府仍处于既有联盟的政治影响范围之内。

paragraphs.text: That variety gave the common statement its particular significance: cooperation had to be made among countries that were already differently connected.
paragraphs.translation: 这种差异赋予共同声明以特别意义：合作必须在已经具有不同外部联系的国家之间建立。

paragraphs.text: Cooperation could make it harder for an outside power to isolate a single government.
paragraphs.translation: 合作可以使外部强国更难孤立某一个政府。

paragraphs.text: Yet different alliances could also leave an exploitable opening in a coalition that sought solidarity.
paragraphs.translation: 然而，不同的联盟归属，也可能在寻求团结的联合体中留下可乘之隙。

paragraphs.text: The Office of the Historian describes both the meeting's common aims and its variety of loyalties.
paragraphs.translation: 美国历史文献办公室既介绍了会议的共同目标，也介绍了各方不同的政治归属。

paragraphs.text: It also describes the tension in American policy between support for self-determination and reliance on European colonial allies.
paragraphs.translation: 它还介绍了美国政策中的张力：一方面支持自决，另一方面依赖欧洲殖民盟国。

paragraphs.text: Bandung therefore opened a space for action within an unequal world, rather than removing all the inequalities at once.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，万隆是在一个不平等的世界中打开了行动空间，而不是一次性消除了所有不平等。

title: The Sea Returns to the Forest Through a Fish

paragraphs.text: Adults migrate upstream to spawn after a period of life in the ocean.
paragraphs.translation: 成年鱼在海洋中生活一段时间后，向上游洄游产卵。

paragraphs.text: This migration carries living bodies and marine nutrients into the river system.
paragraphs.translation: 这种洄游把活的鱼体与海洋营养物质带入河流系统。

paragraphs.text: A returning migrant is therefore more than an individual moving from one place to another.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，一条返回的洄游鱼，不只是一个从此地移到彼地的个体。

paragraphs.text: The Elwha dams interrupted that connection for much of the watershed.
paragraphs.translation: Elwha河的水坝，曾切断流域大部分地区的这种联系。

paragraphs.text: NOAA Fisheries describes how dam removal reopened access to habitats that anadromous fish had long been unable to reach.
paragraphs.translation: NOAA渔业部门介绍，移坝如何重新开放了溯河洄游鱼类长期无法到达的栖息地。

paragraphs.text: A migratory fish needs connected places for the different stages of its life.
paragraphs.translation: 一种有洄游习性的鱼，需要在生命各阶段所用的地点之间保持连通。

paragraphs.text: The migrational connection depends on the river's physical continuity, not just on suitable water at one isolated site.
paragraphs.translation: 这种迁移联系取决于河流的物理连续性，而不仅是在一个孤立地点存在合适的水。

paragraphs.text: For a sea-going migrator, a barrier can separate a growing place from a breeding place.
paragraphs.translation: 对往返海洋的迁移者而言，一道障碍可以把生长地与繁殖地分开。

paragraphs.text: Restoring a migratory route can consequently change the use of habitat far beyond the former obstruction.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，恢复一条洄游路线，能够改变远超原先障碍位置的栖息地使用情况。

paragraphs.text: A fish may briefly emerge from the water when it leaps an obstacle, carrying its momentum into the air.
paragraphs.translation: 鱼跃过障碍时，可能短暂跃出水面，把运动的冲势带入空中。

paragraphs.text: The nutrient connection continues through the food web.
paragraphs.translation: 营养物质的联系，通过食物网继续延伸。

paragraphs.text: NOAA describes algae supporting invertebrates that in turn feed young salmon.
paragraphs.translation: NOAA介绍，藻类支持无脊椎动物，而无脊椎动物又供幼鲑取食。

paragraphs.text: Returning adults bring marine nutrients back upstream, helping sustain primary production.
paragraphs.translation: 返回的成年鱼把海洋营养物质带回上游，有助于维持初级生产。

paragraphs.text: The research also follows how disturbed invertebrate communities recover in density and diversity at different rates.
paragraphs.translation: 研究还追踪受扰动的无脊椎动物群落，在密度与多样性方面以不同速度恢复的情况。

title: The Convention Floor Became a Broadcasting Space

paragraphs.text: A party convention gathers delegates to conduct formal business while presenting a political event to a much wider public.
paragraphs.translation: 政党大会召集代表处理正式事务，同时把一场政治事件呈现给更广泛的公众。

paragraphs.text: At the Democratic nominating convention in Chicago in August 1968, Hubert Humphrey became the party's presidential candidate.
paragraphs.translation: 在1968年8月芝加哥的民主党提名大会上，Hubert Humphrey成为该党的总统候选人。

paragraphs.text: Chicago Public Library's finding aid describes a meeting accompanied by anti-war demonstrations and police violence outside.
paragraphs.translation: 芝加哥公共图书馆的检索指南介绍，这场大会伴随着外面的反战示威和警察暴力。

paragraphs.text: The library preserves records ranging from schedules and seating charts to statements and alternative newspapers.
paragraphs.translation: 图书馆保存的记录，从日程表、座位图，到声明及另类报纸，种类广泛。

paragraphs.text: At a party convention, an alternate can stand ready to replace a delegate who cannot serve.
paragraphs.translation: 在政党代表大会上，候补代表可以准备替代无法履职的代表。

paragraphs.text: The Smithsonian Archives adds a technological history to that political setting.
paragraphs.translation: 史密森学会档案馆，为那个政治背景补充了一段技术史。

paragraphs.text: Its account describes portable, battery-powered microphone equipment used by NBC commentators at the 1968 conventions.
paragraphs.translation: 其介绍描述了NBC评论员在1968年各次大会上使用的便携式电池供电话筒设备。

paragraphs.text: Two-way communication connected a reporter on the floor with a director in the booth.
paragraphs.translation: 双向通信把会场中的记者与播报间里的导播连接起来。

paragraphs.text: A network could transmit an interview while the director coordinated its place in the coverage.
paragraphs.translation: 电视网可以播送一段采访，同时由导播协调它在报道中的位置。

paragraphs.text: The transmission of a report thus depended on both a moving journalist and a coordinated technical system.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，报道的播出，既依赖移动的记者，也依赖协调运作的技术系统。

paragraphs.text: Viewers received a television transmission assembled through decisions about timing, location and speakers.
paragraphs.translation: 观众接收到的电视节目，由有关时间、地点和发言者的选择编排而成。

paragraphs.text: The media carried the convention beyond the people physically present in the hall.
paragraphs.translation: 媒体把大会带到了亲自在会场者之外的人们面前。

paragraphs.text: Mass media made a selected sequence of local moments available to audiences in many homes.
paragraphs.translation: 大众媒体把经过选择的一系列现场时刻，送到许多家庭的观众面前。

paragraphs.text: Later archives preserve another kind of access, in which a reader can move between an event's programme, images and subsequent descriptions.
paragraphs.translation: 后来的档案保存了另一种接触方式，让读者能够在事件的议程、图像及后续描述之间往返。

paragraphs.text: A computer-based multimedia account can bring those forms together, while hypermedia links allow different paths through them.
paragraphs.translation: 基于计算机的多媒体记述，可以把这些形式汇集起来，而超媒体链接让人们能够沿不同路径阅读。

paragraphs.text: To archive inactive digital files can move them from working storage to cheaper long-term storage while keeping them retrievable.
paragraphs.translation: 把不再常用的数字文件归档，可以将其从工作存储移到较便宜的长期存储中，同时保留日后检索的能力。

title: Recovery Belongs to a Whole Life

paragraphs.text: The NCCIH describes whole person health through interconnected biological, behavioural, social and environmental domains.
paragraphs.translation: 美国NCCIH通过相互关联的生物、行为、社会和环境领域，描述全人健康。

paragraphs.text: Its account of integrative health emphasizes coordination among approaches, providers and institutions.
paragraphs.translation: 其对整合健康的说明，强调方法、服务提供者与机构之间的协调。

paragraphs.text: Alternative medicine is used in place of conventional medical care, in the terminology explained by the NCCIH.
paragraphs.translation: 按照NCCIH解释的术语，替代医学被用来取代常规医疗。

paragraphs.text: A complementary approach is used alongside conventional care.
paragraphs.translation: 补充性方法则与常规医疗同时使用。

paragraphs.text: An approach's place in the care arrangement does not by itself establish what it can accomplish.
paragraphs.translation: 一种方法在照护安排中的位置，本身并不能证明它能够达成什么效果。

paragraphs.text: The fact sheet, last updated in April 2021, gives a concrete example: a collaborative model for veterans with spine pain and related mental-health conditions.
paragraphs.translation: 这份最后更新于2021年4月的说明资料，给出了一个具体例子：为患有脊柱疼痛及相关心理健康问题的退役军人建立协作模式。

paragraphs.text: It brings chiropractors, primary-care providers and mental-health providers into the same model, rather than asking one profession to cover every need.
paragraphs.translation: 这一模式把脊椎矫正从业者、初级医疗服务者与心理健康服务者纳入同一安排，而不是让一种专业包揽所有需求。

paragraphs.text: The same account describes cancer centres offering symptom support alongside conventional cancer treatment, while characterising research into such programmes as early-stage.
paragraphs.translation: 同一份资料还介绍，癌症中心在常规癌症治疗之外提供症状支持，同时将对这类项目的研究描述为仍处于早期阶段。

paragraphs.text: Excess pigmentation can leave a patch of skin darker than the surrounding area.
paragraphs.translation: 色素过度沉积，可以使一块皮肤比周围区域更深。

paragraphs.text: The National Cancer Institute's definition connects hyperpigmentation with excess melanin and lists several possible causes.
paragraphs.translation: 美国国家癌症研究所的定义，把色素过多与过量黑色素联系起来，并列出多种可能原因。

paragraphs.text: The NCI lists skin injury, sun damage and certain medicines, including some anticancer drugs, among the possible causes.
paragraphs.translation: 美国国家癌症研究所列出的可能原因，包括皮肤损伤、日晒损伤，以及某些药物，其中包括部分抗癌药。

paragraphs.text: Recovering from illness can also demand psychological integration, as conflicting wishes for independence and support find a workable place in the same person's life.
paragraphs.translation: 从疾病中恢复，也可能需要心理整合，让对独立与支持的矛盾愿望，在同一个人的生活中找到可以共处的位置。

paragraphs.text: Restorative sleep can help a tired person regain strength.
paragraphs.translation: 具有恢复作用的睡眠，可以帮助疲惫的人重获精力。

paragraphs.text: A nourishing meal may serve as a restorative when hunger and exhaustion have left someone weak.
paragraphs.translation: 饥饿与疲惫使人虚弱时，一顿有营养的饭可以起到恢复元气的作用。

paragraphs.text: A quiet period away from daily demands can act restoratively without being a treatment for the underlying disease.
paragraphs.translation: 暂时远离日常事务的一段安静时光，可以使人恢复精力，却不等于治疗了根本疾病。

title: Keeping a Rainforest Alive While Its Glass House Changes

paragraphs.text: Kew's Palm House opened in 1848, using a large iron-and-glass structure to house tropical plants in London.
paragraphs.translation: 邱园棕榈温室于1848年开放，用大型铁与玻璃结构在伦敦容纳热带植物。

paragraphs.text: The nearby Princess of Wales Conservatory provides another approach, with ten computer-controlled climate zones.
paragraphs.translation: 附近的威尔士王妃温室采用另一种方式，设有十个由计算机控制的气候区。

paragraphs.text: The Palm House now requires major work on its fabric and heating systems.
paragraphs.translation: 棕榈温室如今需要对建筑本体与供热系统进行重大整修。

paragraphs.text: As described in Kew's October 2026 material, plants are being moved before the planned closures and renovation in 2027.
paragraphs.translation: 按照邱园2026年10月的材料，在计划于2027年进行的关闭与整修之前，植物正在迁出。

paragraphs.text: Some medium-sized specimens can be moved intact, while others are too large for that operation.
paragraphs.translation: 有些中等大小的植株可以整体搬走，而另一些太大，无法这样搬迁。

paragraphs.text: Horticulturists take seeds and cuttings to preserve plants that cannot be moved as they stand.
paragraphs.translation: 园艺人员采集种子和插条，以保存无法原样搬走的植物。

paragraphs.text: Where possible, moved plants will later be restored to the renovated house.
paragraphs.translation: 在可行情况下，搬走的植物日后将被放回整修后的温室。

paragraphs.text: If a plant begins to outgrow a temporary space, the team may need to anticipate its next move, bringing it forward rather than waiting for the original date.
paragraphs.translation: 如果一株植物开始长得超出临时空间所能容纳的范围，团队可能需要把它的下一次搬迁提前，而不等到原定日期。

paragraphs.text: Kew plans to replace the gas boilers with an electrified heat-pump system and use renewable electricity.
paragraphs.translation: 邱园计划用电气化热泵系统替代燃气锅炉，并使用可再生电力。

paragraphs.text: Alternative energy is part of the plan, alongside reducing heat lost through the glazing.
paragraphs.translation: 替代能源是计划的一部分，同时还要减少从玻璃围护结构流失的热量。

paragraphs.text: The project includes replacement glass and improved seals, as well as conservation of the existing structure.
paragraphs.translation: 项目包含更换玻璃、改善密封，以及保存既有结构。

paragraphs.text: Tests have examined how to remove and clean panes and how to shift old paint from the ironwork.
paragraphs.translation: 相关试验已经研究了怎样拆卸和清洁玻璃，以及怎样从铁构件上去掉旧漆。

paragraphs.text: An observer following alternate leaves up a stem finds one leaf at each node, placed successively rather than in opposing pairs.
paragraphs.translation: 观察者沿茎向上查看互生叶，会发现每个节上有一片叶，依次着生，而不是两两对生。

paragraphs.text: Persistent leaves remain attached across a season in which deciduous plants lose theirs.
paragraphs.translation: 宿存叶跨过落叶植物落叶的季节，仍然附着在植株上。

paragraphs.text: A domestic conservatory may instead give people a sunny room in which to sit, read or meet.
paragraphs.translation: 住宅里的日光房，则可能为人们提供一个可以坐着、阅读或相聚的阳光房间。

title: The Printed Word and the Moving Voice

paragraphs.text: A written English word can outlast the pronunciation that first made its spelling seem straightforward.
paragraphs.translation: 一个书面英语词，可能比起初使其拼写显得直接的那种发音存在得更久。

paragraphs.text: Harvard's Chaucer teaching material connects differences between Middle and Modern English with the Great Vowel Shift.
paragraphs.translation: 哈佛的乔叟教学材料，把中古英语与现代英语之间的差别，与元音大推移联系起来。

paragraphs.text: That sound shift changed patterns among long stressed vowels over generations.
paragraphs.translation: 这场音变经过数代人，改变了重读长元音之间的模式。

paragraphs.text: Such changes can modify a linguistic unit's sound while leaving a familiar written form behind.
paragraphs.translation: 这种变化可以改变语言单位的语音，却留下熟悉的书写形式。

paragraphs.text: The page also describes sixteenth-century attempts to redesign spelling so that written signs would fit contemporary speech more closely.
paragraphs.translation: 该网页还介绍了十六世纪重新设计拼写的尝试，目的是让书写符号更接近当时的语音。

paragraphs.text: Historical spelling debates therefore preserve evidence about how people heard their own language.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，历史上的拼写争论，保存了人们怎样听见自己语言的证据。

paragraphs.text: On a standard computer keyboard, the Shift key can change a letter's case without changing the word's pronunciation.
paragraphs.translation: 在标准电脑键盘上，Shift键可以改变字母的大小写，却不改变词语的读音。

paragraphs.text: In the phrase a small stone bridge, small modifies bridge by adding a property to the noun.
paragraphs.translation: 在a small stone bridge这一短语中，small通过给名词增加一种属性来修饰bridge。

paragraphs.text: Stone acts as a noun modifier, classifying the bridge by its material.
paragraphs.translation: stone起着名词修饰语的作用，按材料给桥分类。

paragraphs.text: Cambridge's grammar account explains that adjectives generally precede these noun modifiers.
paragraphs.translation: 剑桥语法说明解释，形容词通常位于这些名词修饰语之前。

paragraphs.text: This helps explain why small stone bridge has a usual order rather than being an indiscriminate collection of three words.
paragraphs.translation: 这有助于解释，为什么small stone bridge有通常的词序，而不是三个词杂乱堆成的集合。

paragraphs.text: Indiscriminateness in word order would obscure the relationships that make the phrase useful.
paragraphs.translation: 词序上的杂乱，会使这个短语之所以有用的关系变得模糊。

paragraphs.text: A reader discriminates among these functions even when the process feels automatic.
paragraphs.translation: 即使这个过程感觉是自动完成的，读者仍在区分这些功能。

paragraphs.text: A late colleague and a colleague who is late do not ordinarily give the same information.
paragraphs.translation: a late colleague与a colleague who is late，通常提供不同的信息。

paragraphs.text: In the first, late can refer to someone who has died; in the second, it usually concerns arrival after the expected time.
paragraphs.translation: 在前者中，late可以指已经去世的人；在后者中，它通常涉及晚于预期时间到达。

paragraphs.text: The example asks a reader to attend discriminately to the whole construction.
paragraphs.translation: 这个例子要求读者有分辨地注意整个结构。

paragraphs.text: A precise, formal teacher may insist on such distinctions even when a casual conversation supplies enough context to repair a mistake.
paragraphs.translation: 一位严谨刻板的教师，可能会坚持这些区别，即使在随意交谈中，语境足以弥补一次错误。

title: A Memory Needs a Route Back

paragraphs.text: OpenStax separates memory into encoding, storage and retrieval, three functions that ask different questions.
paragraphs.translation: OpenStax把记忆区分为编码、储存与提取，这三种功能对应不同的问题。

paragraphs.text: Encoding concerns how information enters the system; retrieval concerns how it becomes available again.
paragraphs.translation: 编码涉及信息如何进入系统；提取涉及信息怎样再次可用。

paragraphs.text: Retention is the ability to keep learned information in memory so that it remains available later.
paragraphs.translation: 记忆保持，是使学过的信息日后仍保存在记忆中、可供使用的能力。

paragraphs.text: A retentive memory can hold information well, yet a person may still need a useful cue to find a particular memory.
paragraphs.translation: 善于记住事物的记忆，能够很好地保持信息，但人仍可能需要有用的线索，才能找到某一项特定记忆。

paragraphs.text: The textbook describes experiments in which attention to meaning improved later memory for verbal material.
paragraphs.translation: 教材介绍了一些实验：关注意义，改善了之后对语言材料的记忆。

paragraphs.text: A sentence that first seems puzzling can become easier to remember once a fitting context is supplied.
paragraphs.translation: 一句起初令人困惑的话，在得到合适语境之后，可能变得更容易记住。

paragraphs.text: When someone reads retentively, new information becomes connected with material that can later help call it back.
paragraphs.translation: 有人以能够记住内容的方式阅读时，新信息会与日后有助于唤回它的材料连接起来。

paragraphs.text: The chapter also discusses memory as organized through associations rather than a single undifferentiated list.
paragraphs.translation: 该章还讨论，记忆可以通过关联来组织，而不是存成一个没有区分的单一列表。

paragraphs.text: Activating one concept can make related concepts easier to reach.
paragraphs.translation: 激活一个概念，可以让相关概念更容易被提取。

paragraphs.text: A familiar melody may bring back words that would be difficult to recite without it.
paragraphs.translation: 熟悉的旋律，可能唤回离开旋律便难以背出的歌词。

paragraphs.text: An example tied to an experience can supply a different cue.
paragraphs.translation: 与经历联系起来的例子，可以提供另一种线索。

paragraphs.text: People who teach become transmitters of knowledge partly by helping others form these connections.
paragraphs.translation: 教师之所以成为知识的传递者，部分就在于帮助他人建立这些连接。

title: Reading the Gaps in a Greek Inscription

paragraphs.text: Stone can retain the terms of a lease or the wording of a law long after the people concerned have disappeared.
paragraphs.translation: 即使当事人早已不在人世，石头仍能保存租约的条款或法律的措辞。

paragraphs.text: Yet one missing group of letters may determine whether a passage names an alliance, an assembly, or another institution.
paragraphs.translation: 然而，一组缺失的字母就可能决定一段文字说的是同盟、议会，还是另一种机构。

paragraphs.text: In 2022, DeepMind and academic collaborators presented Ithaca, a system trained to restore damaged ancient Greek texts and suggest their time and place of origin.
paragraphs.translation: 2022年，DeepMind与学术合作者介绍了Ithaca：一个经过训练、可补复残损古希腊文献并建议其年代和出处的系统。

paragraphs.text: It processes characters as well as words, because a fragment may preserve only part of a word.
paragraphs.translation: 它既处理单个字符，也处理词语，因为残片可能只留下一个词的一部分。

paragraphs.text: Several restoration hypotheses remain available to the historian rather than disappearing behind a single answer.
paragraphs.translation: 历史学者可以看到多个缺文复原假说，而不只是看见一个掩盖其他可能的答案。

paragraphs.text: A historian working in isolation can bring considerable expertise to a fragment, but cannot instantly recall every parallel inscription.
paragraphs.translation: 独自工作的历史学者可以凭借丰富的专业知识研究残片，却无法立即想起每一处相似铭文。

paragraphs.text: In the project's reported evaluation, historians assisted by Ithaca restored text more accurately than either the unassisted historians or the model alone.
paragraphs.translation: 在该项目报告的评估中，得到Ithaca协助的历史学者补复文字的准确度，高于学者独自工作或模型独立工作时的准确度。

paragraphs.text: That result describes an evaluation, not an unlimited power to recover anything once written.
paragraphs.translation: 这一结果描述的是一次评估，而不是一种能够找回所有既有文字的无限能力。

paragraphs.text: Words beside a gap, comparable decrees, and a plausible date can illuminate one another.
paragraphs.translation: 缺口旁的词语、可资对照的法令和合理的年代，可以相互阐明意义。

paragraphs.text: The inscription's isolation is reduced even where the break in the stone remains.
paragraphs.translation: 即使石头上的断口依然存在，铭文与其他材料之间的隔绝也会有所减轻。

title: The Dinosaur with a Spike in the Wrong Place

paragraphs.text: The Crystal Palace Iguanodon has a spike on its nose, where a living Iguanodon would have had none.
paragraphs.translation: 水晶宫的鬣蜥龙塑像鼻部有一根尖刺，而活着的鬣蜥龙那里并没有尖刺。

paragraphs.text: Its striking mistake survives from a serious attempt to restore an extinct animal from incomplete remains.
paragraphs.translation: 这个醒目的错误，来自一次依据不完整遗骸推测复原灭绝动物形态的认真尝试。

paragraphs.text: The restoration gave the public a body to imagine, long before a relatively complete skeleton became available.
paragraphs.translation: 在较为完整的骨架出现之前，这座复原模型已经给公众提供了一个可以想象的身体。

paragraphs.text: Teeth found in Sussex in 1822 resembled those of an iguana on a far larger scale.
paragraphs.translation: 1822年在萨塞克斯发现的牙齿形似鬣蜥的牙齿，尺寸却大得多。

paragraphs.text: Scattered bones added information without making their arrangement obvious.
paragraphs.translation: 散落的骨骼增加了信息，却并未让它们的排列方式变得一目了然。

paragraphs.text: A spike could be fitted into a familiar, rhinoceros-like outline before its true position was understood.
paragraphs.translation: 在人们明白尖刺真正的位置之前，它可以被安放进一种熟悉的、类似犀牛的轮廓中。

paragraphs.text: To isolate one bone from the surrounding rock is to separate structures that reached the excavator as a single buried mass.
paragraphs.translation: 把一块骨骼从周围岩石中分离出来，就是将到达发掘者面前时混为一体的埋藏物分开。

paragraphs.text: That separation makes study possible, while the positions of neighbouring remains can still help explain where the bone belongs.
paragraphs.translation: 这种分离让研究成为可能，而邻近遗骸的位置仍能帮助解释这块骨骼应当安放在哪里。

paragraphs.text: For a time, a nose spike belonged to the conventional wisdom about Iguanodon's form.
paragraphs.translation: 在一段时期内，鼻部有尖刺是人们对鬣蜥龙形态的普遍看法之一。

paragraphs.text: Discoveries in the 1870s established that the spikes belonged to the thumbs.
paragraphs.translation: 19世纪70年代的发现确定了这些尖刺属于拇指。

paragraphs.text: The Bernissart finds of 1878 supplied numerous skeletons, many relatively complete.
paragraphs.translation: 1878年的伯尼萨尔发现提供了大量骨架，其中许多相当完整。

paragraphs.text: Even those skeletons were assembled into an upright posture reflecting nineteenth-century thinking.
paragraphs.translation: 即使是这些骨架，也被组装成了反映19世纪认识的直立姿态。

paragraphs.text: The Natural History Museum explains that Iguanodon predominantly walked on all fours, while the old Belgian mounts are too fragile to rearrange.
paragraphs.translation: 英国自然历史博物馆解释说，鬣蜥龙主要以四足行走，而比利时那些旧装架骨骼已脆弱得无法重新排列。

paragraphs.text: A reconstruction therefore has two histories: the life it depicts and the knowledge available when it was made.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，一件复原作品有两段历史：它所描绘的生命史，以及制作时可用的知识史。

paragraphs.text: It shows how a convincing whole can emerge before every relationship between the surviving parts has been understood.
paragraphs.translation: 它表明：即使幸存各部分之间的关系尚未全部弄清，一个看似可信的整体也可能已经出现。

title: The Hidden Movement Around a Ship

paragraphs.text: A 2009 NAVAIR account describes the removal and redistribution of aviation support equipment from USS Kitty Hawk.
paragraphs.translation: 美国海军航空系统司令部2009年的一篇报道，讲述了从“小鹰号”航空母舰拆卸、卸载并重新分配航空保障设备的过程。

paragraphs.text: Kitty Hawk used conventional propulsion, drawing its shipboard power from a non-nuclear system.
paragraphs.translation: “小鹰号”使用常规动力，以非核动力系统提供舰上动力。

paragraphs.text: Conventional weapons, whose effects do not depend on a nuclear explosion, belong to a different question about what a warship carries.
paragraphs.translation: 破坏效应不依赖核爆炸的常规武器，则属于舰船携带何种装备的另一个问题。

paragraphs.text: The removal team had to coordinate work in San Diego and Bremerton, rather than perform the whole job in one yard.
paragraphs.translation: 卸载团队必须协调圣迭戈和布雷默顿两地的工作，而不是在同一个船厂完成全部任务。

paragraphs.text: A large movement of equipment also required smaller permissions and preparations: job orders, access through bulkheads, lifting arrangements and transport.
paragraphs.translation: 大规模设备搬运也需要更细小的许可与准备：工单、穿过舱壁的通道、起吊安排和运输。

paragraphs.text: The report describes missing job orders being entered and a packing station being organized so that equipment could be sorted, documented and sent onward.
paragraphs.translation: 报道描述了补录缺失工单、组织包装站的过程，以便把设备分类、登记并运往下一站。

paragraphs.text: In Bremerton, limited shore space meant that equipment had to move directly from the ship to waiting trucks.
paragraphs.translation: 在布雷默顿，岸上空间有限，设备需要直接从舰船装上等候的卡车。

paragraphs.text: This was the reverse of the usual process of bringing equipment aboard to prepare a ship for service.
paragraphs.translation: 这与通常把设备运上舰船、为服役做准备的流程恰好相反。

paragraphs.text: Retirement might suggest an end to the equipment's working life; for the items redistributed to other users, the reverse was true.
paragraphs.translation: 退役可能让人想到设备工作寿命的终结；对于重新分配给其他使用者的那些物品，情况却恰恰相反。

paragraphs.text: At sea, the same wider system of supply keeps a vessel away from port for longer.
paragraphs.translation: 在海上，同一个更广泛的补给体系，让舰船能够更长时间不返回港口。

paragraphs.text: A Royal Navy account from October 2024 describes RFA Tidesurge transferring fuel and supplies to allied ships in the North Atlantic.
paragraphs.translation: 英国皇家海军2024年10月的一篇报道，描述了辅助舰队“潮涌号”在北大西洋向盟国舰船输送燃料和物资的情况。

paragraphs.text: During a replenishment evolution, ships manoeuvre into parallel courses and match their speed while lines and hoses connect them.
paragraphs.translation: 在一次补给机动中，舰船调整成平行航向、匹配航速，并以绳索和软管相连。

paragraphs.text: Food and spare parts can also travel by a suspended load beneath a helicopter.
paragraphs.translation: 食品和备件也可以吊挂在直升机下方运输。

paragraphs.text: An individual shift of a heavy load may be brief, but its place in the operation has to be understood.
paragraphs.translation: 一件重物的单次移位可能很短暂，但必须明白它在整体作业中的位置。

paragraphs.text: Cargo that shifts as a hull rolls can put forces where the crew did not intend them.
paragraphs.translation: 随着船体横摇而发生移位的货物，可能把力施加到船员未曾预期的位置。

paragraphs.text: Lifting systems must sustain the strain of repeated use, not merely carry a load once.
paragraphs.translation: 起吊系统必须经受反复使用的应力，而不仅是搬起一次重物。

paragraphs.text: Equipment that has sustained damage may need repair before another crew can rely on it.
paragraphs.translation: 已经遭受损坏的设备，可能必须先修理，另一组人员才能依赖它工作。

title: A Student Room Has More Than One Calendar

paragraphs.text: Nottingham Trent University's private-accommodation guide distinguishes university accommodation from housing booked directly with a private provider.
paragraphs.translation: 诺丁汉特伦特大学的私人住宿指南，区分了大学住宿与直接向私人提供者预订的住房。

paragraphs.text: The person answering a question about a booking may consequently be an agent or private provider rather than the university.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，回答预订问题的人，可能是中介或私人提供者，而不是大学。

paragraphs.text: In its housing guide revised in 2016, St Mary's University describes a summer retainer as reduced rent paid when the student is away.
paragraphs.translation: 在2016年修订的住房指南中，圣玛丽大学把暑期保房租金描述为学生不在时支付的较低租金。

paragraphs.text: NTU's guide also uses retainer for a payment reserving accommodation before a contract begins, without itself granting occupation during that period.
paragraphs.translation: 诺丁汉特伦特大学的指南，也用retainer指合同开始前为预留住房支付的款项，而支付该款本身并不赋予该期间的入住权。

paragraphs.text: The examples show how a student's calendar can separate paying for a room, keeping it available and actually living in it.
paragraphs.translation: 这些例子表明，学生的日历可以把为房间付费、使房间保持可用，以及实际住在其中分开。

paragraphs.text: A cleaning rota might give two housemates responsibility in alternate weeks, so that each takes every other week.
paragraphs.translation: 清洁轮值表可以让两位室友隔周负责，因此每人每隔一周轮到一次。

title: A Phone Call Has Two Routes

paragraphs.text: A telephone call connects two people, but its sound and its bill need not travel in the same direction.
paragraphs.translation: 一次电话连接两个人，但声音与账单未必朝同一个方向传递。

paragraphs.text: A caller can ask an operator to reverse the charges, so that the person receiving the call pays for it.
paragraphs.translation: 拨打者可以请接线员安排由接听方付费，让接电话的人支付通话费用。

paragraphs.text: BT's help page describes this as a reverse-charge or collect call.
paragraphs.translation: BT的帮助页把这种方式称为reverse-charge call或collect call。

paragraphs.text: The page also distinguishes ordinary telephone lines from categories of numbers to which that service does not apply.
paragraphs.translation: 该页还区分了普通电话线路与不适用这项服务的号码类别。

paragraphs.text: A telephone number is therefore more than an address: its type can affect which arrangements the network supports.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，电话号码不只是一个地址；号码类型可以影响网络支持哪些安排。

paragraphs.text: For someone discussing a bill, asking who initiated a call is not quite the same as asking who agreed to pay for it.
paragraphs.translation: 对于讨论账单的人来说，询问谁发起了通话，与询问谁同意付费，并不完全相同。

title: A Hammer on a Roman Coin

paragraphs.text: A Roman denarius entered the Royal Mint Museum through the generosity of the numismatist L. A. Lawrence.
paragraphs.translation: 一枚罗马第纳里银币，通过钱币学家劳伦斯的慷慨捐赠进入了英国皇家铸币博物馆。

paragraphs.text: The museum's account connects his collecting with objects he presented during the 1920s and 1930s.
paragraphs.translation: 博物馆的说明，把他的收藏活动与他在20世纪20至30年代捐赠的物品联系起来。

paragraphs.text: The coin's reverse bears a design involving a hammer and tongs.
paragraphs.translation: 这枚银币的背面有涉及锤和钳的图案。

paragraphs.text: Those implements once seemed to represent the manufacture of coins, making the object especially appropriate for a mint's collection.
paragraphs.translation: 这些工具一度被认为表现了铸币活动，使这件物品显得格外适合铸币机构收藏。

paragraphs.text: The museum also records another interpretation: the tools may refer to Vulcan, the god of metalworking.
paragraphs.translation: 博物馆也记录了另一种解释：这些工具可能指向金属加工之神伏尔甘。

paragraphs.text: At the scale of a coin, an engraver may conventionalize a complicated tool into an established arrangement of lines.
paragraphs.translation: 在钱币这样的小尺度上，雕刻师可以把复杂工具的形态处理成约定俗成的线条组合。

paragraphs.text: A conventional representation follows a visual tradition rather than reproducing every irregular surface of the tool found in a workshop.
paragraphs.translation: 这种因袭画法遵循视觉传统，而不是再现作坊工具表面的每一处不规则细节。

title: Recycling Starts Before and After a Plastic Object Exists

paragraphs.text: A discarded plastic object has at least two structures: the visible shape and the molecular arrangement that makes the shape possible.
paragraphs.translation: 一件废弃塑料制品至少有两种结构：可见的外形，以及使这种外形成为可能的分子排列。

paragraphs.text: A conveyor can carry discarded bottles past a sorting point, organizing their physical journey before any chemical treatment begins.
paragraphs.translation: 输送带可以把废瓶运过分拣点，在化学处理开始前组织它们的物理行程。

paragraphs.text: The sorter still faces mixtures of polymers, colours, additives and products assembled from several layers.
paragraphs.translation: 分拣过程仍然面临聚合物、颜色、添加剂，以及由多层材料构成的产品所形成的混合物。

paragraphs.text: A Department of Energy account from 2021 explains why this complexity continues inside the material.
paragraphs.translation: 美国能源部2021年的一篇报道，说明了这种复杂性为何会延续到材料内部。

paragraphs.text: Polymer chains have chemical bonds that do not simply disappear when a bottle is collected or ground into smaller pieces.
paragraphs.translation: 聚合物长链含有化学键；瓶子被收集起来或磨成小块时，这些键不会就此简单消失。

paragraphs.text: A manufacturer can use an additive as a modifier of flexibility or another working property.
paragraphs.translation: 制造商可以把添加剂用作柔韧性或其他使用性能的调节剂。

paragraphs.text: A chemist who modifies the substituent groups attached to a polymer chain can instead alter properties such as its behaviour in a solvent.
paragraphs.translation: 化学家改变聚合物链上所连的取代基时，则可以改变其在溶剂中的行为等性质。

paragraphs.text: The DOE report describes research on both redesigning plastics and transforming plastics that already exist.
paragraphs.translation: 这篇能源部报道，描述了重新设计塑料和转化既有塑料两方面的研究。

paragraphs.text: At Berkeley's Molecular Foundry, researchers found that a polymer they had designed could break back into its building units under acidic conditions.
paragraphs.translation: 在伯克利分子铸造厂，研究人员发现，他们设计的一种聚合物能够在酸性条件下重新分解为构成单元。

paragraphs.text: They also investigated removing dyes and additives and using the recovered components again.
paragraphs.translation: 他们还研究了去除染料和添加剂，并再次使用回收组分。

paragraphs.text: Other research in the account uses catalysts to turn existing plastics into potentially useful liquids and waxes.
paragraphs.translation: 报道中的其他研究，则利用催化剂把既有塑料转化为可能有用的液体和蜡。

title: Why a Brick Wall Has a Pattern

paragraphs.text: The long face of a brick is its stretcher face; the short end is its header face.
paragraphs.translation: 砖的长面叫顺面，短端面叫丁面。

paragraphs.text: Wienerberger's technical guide explains how different arrangements of those faces produce different bonds.
paragraphs.translation: 维纳博艮的技术指南，说明了这些砖面的不同排列怎样形成不同组砌方式。

paragraphs.text: In a common stretcher bond, the shift between successive courses places each vertical joint over the body of a brick below.
paragraphs.translation: 在常见的顺砖组砌中，相邻砖层之间的错缝，使每条竖缝落在下层砖的砖身上。

paragraphs.text: English bond alternates courses of headers and stretchers, whereas Flemish bond combines the two within a course.
paragraphs.translation: 英式组砌让丁砖层与顺砖层交替出现，而佛兰芒式组砌则在一层中结合两者。

paragraphs.text: The guide also describes stack bond, in which the bricks line up without the usual overlap.
paragraphs.translation: 该指南还描述了叠砌法，其中砖块对齐，没有通常的搭接。

paragraphs.text: Its appearance and structural requirements differ from those of bonded arrangements with overlapping courses.
paragraphs.translation: 它的外观和结构要求，与砖层搭接的组砌方式不同。

paragraphs.text: Mortar joints add another scale of design through their profile and weather exposure.
paragraphs.translation: 灰缝通过自身形状以及经受风雨的方式，增加了另一个设计尺度。

title: The Stillness Around a Memorial

paragraphs.text: A memorial ceremony can make a familiar military formation carry a different meaning.
paragraphs.translation: 纪念仪式可以让一种熟悉的军事队形承载不同的意义。

paragraphs.text: The Army Museum of South Australia describes a catafalque party standing around a coffin or a memorial.
paragraphs.translation: 南澳大利亚陆军博物馆介绍了围站在棺木或纪念碑周围的守灵警卫。

paragraphs.text: Four members of the guard face outward with their heads bowed.
paragraphs.translation: 四名警卫面向外侧，低下头。

paragraphs.text: They reverse arms as a gesture of mourning, holding their weapons in the reversed ceremonial position.
paragraphs.translation: 他们倒持武器，以这一仪式姿势表示哀悼。

paragraphs.text: The formation directs the guard's gaze away from the centre while keeping the centre protected and acknowledged.
paragraphs.translation: 这种队形让警卫的目光朝向中心之外，同时使中心得到守护和致敬。

paragraphs.text: The museum connects the practice with both lying in state and occasions of remembrance such as Anzac Day.
paragraphs.translation: 博物馆把这一做法与遗体供瞻仰的守灵，以及澳新军团日等纪念场合联系起来。

title: The Hurricane Had Two Eyewalls

paragraphs.text: In September 2023, NASA researcher Patrick Duran joined NOAA P-3 flights through Hurricane Lee.
paragraphs.translation: 2023年9月，NASA研究人员帕特里克·杜兰搭乘美国国家海洋和大气管理局的P-3飞机，穿越飓风“李”。

paragraphs.text: His research concerned lightning in the inner eyewall and its relationship to clouds and rising air.
paragraphs.translation: 他的研究涉及内眼墙中的闪电，以及闪电与云和上升气流的关系。

paragraphs.text: The first flight found a small, elliptical eye without lightning at that time.
paragraphs.translation: 第一次飞行发现了一个小型椭圆形风眼，当时那里没有闪电。

paragraphs.text: A later flight encountered lightning, showing the scientist a changing version of the structure he had studied from a distance.
paragraphs.translation: 后一次飞行遇到了闪电，让这位科学家看到了他此前从远处研究的结构正在变化的样子。

paragraphs.text: On 11 September, the storm was forming a secondary eyewall around its existing one.
paragraphs.translation: 9月11日，风暴正在原有眼墙外形成第二道眼墙。

paragraphs.text: The aircraft orbited around the eye while a radar in its tail collected information about both eyewalls.
paragraphs.translation: 飞机在风眼周围盘旋，尾部雷达同时收集两道眼墙的信息。

paragraphs.text: Secondary eyewall formation matters because it can affect the intensity of a strong hurricane.
paragraphs.translation: 第二道眼墙的形成之所以重要，是因为它可以影响强飓风的强度。

paragraphs.text: The NASA account presents the observations as material for further study, including questions about electrification.
paragraphs.translation: NASA的报道把这些观测作为进一步研究的材料，其中包括带电过程方面的问题。
